question: I receive the Canada child benefit but have no taxable income this year. Do I still have to file a tax return to keep receiving it?
generated_answer: Yes, you still need to file a tax return to keep receiving the Canada child benefit (CCB). Even if you have no taxable income, filing a return ensures that the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) has the information they need to continue your CCB payments. The CRA uses the information from your tax return to determine your eligibility and the amount of the benefit you should receive. If you don't file a return, your CCB payments may be suspended until you do. So, make sure to file your tax return on time to avoid any interruptions in your benefit payments.
